/compare/.name: Before You Give Your Dog a Long-Lasting Chew: 5-Step Checklist
/compare/.description: A quick checklist before you give your dog a long-lasting chew like a bully stick, yak cheese chew, beef cheek roll or antler: supervise, pick a size and hardness that suits your dog (follow the brand's size guidance), remove small or broken pieces, keep water available, and ask your vet. Nibbables doesn't rate safety; it quotes each brand's own page.
